title: Keto Uruguayan Cheese Bread
description: A keto twist on traditional Uruguayan cheese bread, made with a hollow dough and topped with melted cheese.
instructions: 2. Place the hollow dough on a baking sheet.
3. Sprinkle shredded aerated cheese evenly over the dough.

5. Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
